rationale: The refactor moves both the copy button (formerly native enableCellCopy) and the drilldown search icon into one floating #cell-hover-actions toolbar with new data-test hooks. The positive paths are already covered and were updated in the diff: dashboard-table-copy-cell.spec.js covers formatted-copy/clipboard/pivot, dashboard-legends-copy.spec.js covers the data-copied check-icon state and the empty-cell copy-hidden case, and interactive-dashboard-table.spec.js (via dashboard-cell-explorer.js) covers the drilldown drawer + URL params. The single genuinely uncovered surface is the column-dependent gating of the unified toolbar: on a drillable (plain) cell BOTH copy + drilldown appear, while on an aggregated Y-axis column ONLY copy appears (no drilldown). Two new test() cases appended to the drilldown area spec close that gap without duplicating existing copy/drilldown positives.
